MiniSearch provides build-time trie serialization and eager serverless deserialization for sub-millisecond keyword lookup.
ADR Problem: Runtime keyword searching or cold-start database queries introduce latency overheads for user-facing chats.
ADR Decision: Pre-compile documents into a MiniSearch index at build-time and load the serialized JSON eager-instantiated.
